title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Iva Primorac Pavicic and Beatrise Zeltina in the W15 Paris, Main Draw, originally scheduled for November 14, 2026 at 4:30AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Iva Primorac Pavicic' if Iva Primorac Pavicic advances against Beatrise Zeltina.

This market will resolve to 'Beatrise Zeltina' if Beatrise Zeltina advances against Iva Primorac Pavicic.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by November 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation (ITF). A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
